atAGlance: Miến xào hải sản is glass noodles stir-fried with seafood, usually with shrimp, squid, vegetables, and garlic.
whatItIs: Miến xào hải sản is glass noodles stir-fried with shrimp, squid, fish cake, or mixed seafood. The noodles soak up garlic, seafood juices, and wok seasoning.
howToEnjoy: Eat it hot while the glass noodles are slippery and the seafood is tender. If shellfish is a concern, ask what seafood is included before ordering.
howLocalsOrder: Order miến xào hải sản for a shared seafood noodle plate. Ask ít cay, ít dầu, or no shellfish before the wok starts.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, miến turns translucent and springy, so this seafood plate feels lighter than egg-noodle stir-fries even when the shrimp and squid flavor is strong.
goodToKnow: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
